payload.name: Extract Explicit Media Evaluations
payload.description: When a user gives a first-person evaluative description of a specific movie, show, book, game, or other media item, extract the item and its stated qualities into memory.
content: During extraction, if a message contains a first-person evaluation of a specific media item (movie, show, book, game, etc.) with explicit descriptive words, create one durable preference or event memory capturing the item, the speaker, and the exact evaluative descriptors.
Use the user's own quality words (e.g., gripping, great actors) rather than a generic summary like 'liked it'.
Do not infer qualities that were not stated, and create at most one candidate per distinct media item mentioned.

solves: Users often state evaluative opinions about media they watched, read, or played (e.g., 'the story was gripping', 'the actors were great'). These explicit subjective assessments are missed during extraction, so later questions about how the user described the media cannot be answered. This skill ensures such first-person media evaluations are captured as durable memories.
